name: @eq-solutions/contracts
author: CDC Solutions Pty Ltd
description: Canonical cross-app contracts for the EQ suite. v0.1: the Shell→Service login-handoff JWT app_metadata claim shape (ShellHandoffClaims) + a dependency-free runtime validator. Single source of truth imported by eq-shell (mint side) and eq-service (consume side), so the contract is enforced at compile time (shared type) and runtime (validator) on both ends.
